children.name: Aplexa hypnorum
children.description: Aplexa hypnorum, or by the common name, the moss bladder snail, is a species of small air-breathing freshwater snail.

children.name: Stenophysa marmorata
children.description: Stenophysa marmorata, also known as marbled aplexa, is a species of small, air-breathing freshwater snail of the family Physidae.

children.name: Physa fontinalis
children.description: Physa fontinalis, common name the common bladder snail, is a species of air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusc in the family Physidae.

children.name: Physa skinneri D.W.Taylor, 1954
children.description: Physa skinneri, common name the glass physa, is a species of freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusc in the family Physidae.

children.name: Physella acuta
children.description: Physella acuta, also known as the European physa, tadpole snail, sewage snail, bladder snail, or acute bladder snail, is a species of small, air-breathing freshwater snail of the family Physidae.

children.name: Physella gyrina
children.description: Physella gyrina, common name the "tadpole physa", is a species of small, left-handed or sinistral, air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Physidae.

children.name: Sibirenauta elongata
children.description: Sibirenauta elongata is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Physidae.
